checks.result: passed; 6 selected tests, 0 failures including 3 registry tests

acceptance_evidence.reference: The actor-isolated registry authenticates the current peer UID, private 0600 socket posture, and per-launch challenge digest; validates bounded leases and roots; rejects stale, duplicate, cross-task, and spoofed registrations; expires and ends sessions without persisting a secret. Process identity is PID plus start time, preventing PID reuse collisions. The macOS libproc inspector captures the live process and bounded ancestry. Correlation links unique descendants at tool-linked confidence, downgrades unique workspace/time matches to inferred, leaves ambiguous overlapping tasks unknown, ignores expired registrations, and sums only evidence assigned to the requested task.

discovered_risks: Local ancestry snapshots are point-in-time; processes that exit before inspection may require the optional privileged event observer for stronger evidence.
The registry is in-memory by design and must be exposed only behind the private authenticated IPC service implemented by the connector node.
Workspace-only correlations are intentionally inferred, and overlapping workspaces intentionally produce unknown rather than choosing a task.

evidence: All changed source and test files are confined to the declared Sessions and Correlation scopes.

Registry tests reject wrong UID, public socket mode, stale requests, duplicate sessions, and the same process identity assigned to concurrent tasks. The challenge comparison is length-aware and constant-time over UTF-8 bytes; only its digest is retained.
Active sessions end explicitly or expire at their bounded deadline. Ended/expired sessions remain available for historical interpretation but cannot claim later events.

ProcessIdentity equality and hashing combine PID and start time. A test registers two generations of one PID without collision, and a live libproc smoke identifies the current test process and ancestry.

Synthetic descendant linkage selects the correct concurrent task at tool-linked confidence. Unique workspace-time evidence is inferred; overlapping workspaces, stale registrations, absent matches, and reused-PID mismatches remain unknown.
TaskImpact includes only correlated events for the requested opaque session ID and does not roll ambiguous or outside-root events into a task total.
Session-focused tests, correlation-focused tests, all 67 repository tests, swift build, and git diff --check passed.
